headword: {総合病院|そうごうびょういん}

definitions.explanation: A hospital with multiple departments and specialties, offering a wide range of medical services under one roof.

examples.japanese: {総合病院|そうごうびょういん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had an examination at the general hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{総合病院|そうごうびょういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are two large general hospitals in this town.

examples.english: Without a referral letter, the initial consultation fee at a general hospital can be higher.

notes:
A {総合病院|そうごうびょういん} is a hospital that houses multiple specialized departments such as internal medicine, surgery, pediatrics, and orthopedics. In Japan, general hospitals typically have 100 or more beds and are distinguished from smaller clinics (⟦{診療所|しんりょうじょ}→診療所：14205_shinryoujo⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総合病院|そうごうびょういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧ — to attend a general hospital regularly
- {総合病院|そうごうびょういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}する→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧ — to be admitted to a general hospital
- {総合病院|そうごうびょういん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ — to have surgery at a general hospital

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{診療所|しんりょうじょ}→診療所：14205_shinryoujo⟧ / ⟦クリニック→クリニック：08941_kurinikku⟧ — smaller clinic, often single-specialty
- {大学病院|だいがくびょういん} — university hospital, affiliated with a medical school
- {専門病院|せんもんびょういん} — specialized hospital focusing on one area

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's healthcare system encourages patients to visit a local clinic first and get a referral (⟦{紹介状|しょうかいじょう}→紹介状：23208_shoukaijou⟧) before going to a general hospital. Since 2016, many general hospitals charge an extra fee ({選定療養費|せんていりょうようひ}) for patients who come without a referral.
